title: A documented component library with Storybook

videos.script:
A component is used on many screens, and on each one it is in a different state. Done, not done, empty, too long. Nobody clicks through the whole app to see all of them.

{{workshop}} So this lesson builds a workshop. Storybook shows each component on its own, in every state you write down, beside its documentation.

{{components}} First the planner's components come out of the page code, as three small functions. Then the stories: one file per component, one export per state, written in a format called Component Story Format.

{{themes}} Every story is shown in both themes from the last lesson, with a switch in the toolbar.

{{tests}} Then the stories become tests. Playwright opens each one, takes a picture, and checks it with axe. You will change a radius and watch the picture test fail. And you will make a grey too light, and watch the picture test pass it, and axe catch it.

{{static}} And Storybook builds to a static folder. Which, after lesson 1, you already know how to deploy.
